coordinator_address.description: Address of coordinator in 'host:port' format (e.g., "127.0.0.1:31511"). The value cannot be empty.

coordinator_rpc_stub_cache_size.description: Maximum coordinator RPC stub cache size.

coordinator_topology_max_active_clusters.description: Maximum active topology clusters in [2, 32]. Restart Coordinator after changing it.

coordinator_raft_initial_peers.description: Comma-separated Coordinator Raft initial peers in 'host:port' format. Empty means single-node no-election mode. Configure multiple peers to enable static-peers Raft election.

coordinator_raft_data_dir.description: Exclusive local data root for Coordinator Raft term, vote, log, and snapshot state.

coordinator_raft_heartbeat_interval_ms.description: Coordinator Raft heartbeat interval in milliseconds. Must be in [10, 10000].

coordinator_raft_election_timeout_ms.description: Coordinator Raft election timeout in milliseconds. Must be an integer multiple of coordinator_raft_heartbeat_interval_ms with a ratio in [5, 10].

coordinator_member_failure_grace_ms.description: Continuous voting-member failure grace period in milliseconds. Must be greater than the internal health-check interval.

coordinator_discovery_retry_interval_ms.description: Minimum interval between Coordinator candidate Discovery retries in milliseconds. Must be greater than 0.

watch_event_dispatch_thread.description: Number of coordinator watch event dispatch threads.

rpc_thread_num.description: Config rpc server thread number, must be great equal than 0.

log_dir.description: If specified, logfiles are written into this directory instead of the default logging directory.

log_filename.description: Prefix of log filename. Only letters, digits, and underscores are allowed when non-empty.

minloglevel.description: Messages below this level are not logged.

log_async_queue_size.description: Size of async logger's message queue.

max_log_size.description: Approx. maximum log file size (in MB). A value of 0 will be silently overridden to 1.

max_log_file_num.description: Maximum number of log files to retain per severity level. If set to 0, the log num is not limited.

log_retention_day.description: If greater than 0, log files older than this many days will be removed. If equal 0, log files are not removed by time.

log_async.description: Enable asynchronous writing to log files.

log_compress.description: Compress old log files in .gz format when generated log size exceeds max_log_size.

logbufsecs.description: Buffer log messages for at most this many seconds.

log_only_write_info_file.description: The INFO log file always receives all severities. When true, do not create additional WARNING/ERROR log files.

use_brpc.description: Use brpc instead of ZMQ for RPC communication. When enabled, brpc owns the worker TCP port exclusively (same port as worker_address, no offset) and the ZMQ TCP endpoint is skipped. ZMQ-specific options (zmq_server_io_context, zmq_client_io_context, zmq_client_io_thread, zmq_chunk_sz) do not take effect in brpc mode. Per-service thread pools (rpc_thread_num, oc_thread_num, etc.) still apply. Default is true (also reads the DATASYSTEM_USE_BRPC env var).

brpc_server_num_threads.description: Number of brpc server worker threads (bthread worker pool size). Default is 64.

brpc_max_concurrency.description: Max concurrent in-flight RPCs per brpc server. 0 means unlimited. Recommended: brpc_server_num_threads * 2 (e.g. 128 for 64 threads). When exceeded, brpc returns ELIMIT immediately so a slow handler cannot exhaust bthreads and cause OOM. Must not be smaller than brpc_server_num_threads. Default is 128.

request_sample_rate.description: Sample rate for request logs (0.0-1.0). Default 1.0 means all request logs are sampled.

access_sample_rate.description: Sample rate for access logs (0.0-1.0). Default 1.0 means all access logs are sampled.

diagnostic_sample_rate.description: Sample rate for diagnostic logs (0.0-1.0). Default 1.0 means all diagnostic logs are sampled.
